messages.en: Can you send that file over as soon as possible? The boss is about to go into a meeting.
Sure, I've just got one more page to check, then I'll send it straight over.

senses.en_definition: Currently doing something or being in an ongoing state.

collocations.en: when the sun is directly overhead

senses.en_definition: Moderate or medium in size, degree, or extent; not excessive.
Sufficient or suitable; of the right size.
Whereas; when in fact; used to introduce a contrasting fact.
Even if; although; used to introduce a concession or an emphatic comparison.

messages.en: Are you free? Just wanted to give you a quick call.
I'm eating at home right now. I'll call you back in a bit, okay?
Okay, enjoy your food. Just call me when you're done.

senses.en_definition: Delicious; pleasant to the taste, smell, or other senses.
Comfortable; feeling physically well or emotionally at ease.

messages.en: Have you tried the cakes I gave you earlier? Are they good?
They're so good! If you go to that stall again tomorrow, can you get me a couple?

senses.en_definition: Aware of or coming to understand the true situation; to realize.
Awake or conscious; to wake up or regain consciousness.

messages.en: Found your keys yet? I even looked under the sofa, but they're not there.
Found them. I only just realized they've been in my jacket pocket this whole time!
